subject: Mathematics: Analysis & Approaches

stem: The table records leg length L and race time T.

parts.label: a
parts.html: Find the regression line of T on L.

questions.title: Regression and correlation
solution: Technology gives T=-0.674667L+123.140 and r=-0.999365. At L=84, T=66.5 s.

stem: A boat observes the top of a vertical cliff at 18 degrees. After moving 80 m toward the cliff, the angle is 43 degrees. Let x be the remaining horizontal distance and h the cliff height.
questions.title: Angles of elevation
solution: tan43=h/x and tan18=h/(x+80). Hence x tan43=(x+80)tan18, so x=80tan18/(tan43-tan18)=42.8 m. Then h=x tan43=39.9 m.

stem: The volume in a balloon is V=4+16e^(-kt), k>0. Find V(0). Given V(5)=12, find k and then the time when V=6. [5]
questions.title: Exponential decay model

parts.label: a
parts.html: Express all probabilities in terms of k.

questions.title: Discrete probability distribution
solution: Probabilities are k,2k,4k,8k,16k. Their sum is 31k=1, so k=1/31. E(X)=(1+4+12+32+80)/31=129/31.

stem: A sector of radius R and angle theta>2 radians has area 54 cm^2 and perimeter 30 cm. A concentric sector with the same angle has area 24 cm^2 and radius r.
questions.title: Circular sectors
solution: The equations are R^2 theta/2=54 and R theta+2R=30. Substitution gives R=6 or R=9. These correspond to theta=3 and theta=4/3 respectively, so theta>2 selects R=6, theta=3. Then r^2(3)/2=24, so r=4 cm.

stem: A particle has v(t)=(12-3t)e^(-0.5t)-2sin(t), 0<=t<=6, and s(0)=0.

parts.label: b
parts.html: Find intervals when acceleration is negative.

questions.title: Numerical kinematics
solution: A calculator shows v(t)>0 throughout [0,6], so displacement is greatest at t=6. Numerical integration gives s(6)=integral_0^6 v dt=13.1 m. Acceleration is a(t)=(1.5t-9)e^(-0.5t)-2cos t. Its zeros are 2.46 and 4.61, and sign testing gives a<0 on 0<t<2.46 and 4.61<t<6.

stem: A sphere has diameter endpoints R(3,-1,5), S(-5,3,-1). A closed cuboid has base x by 2x, height y and volume 1200.

parts.label: a
parts.html: Find the sphere centre, radius and volume.

parts.label: b
parts.html: Show the cuboid surface area is A=4x^2+3600/x.

parts.label: c
parts.html: Find the dimensions giving minimum A and justify.

questions.title: Sphere geometry and optimization
solution: Sphere centre=(-1,1,2). The radius is half sqrt(8^2+(-4)^2+6^2)=sqrt29; volume=(4/3)pi(29sqrt29). For the cuboid, 2x^2y=1200 gives y=600/x^2. A=2(2x^2+xy+2xy)=4x^2+6xy=4x^2+3600/x. A'=8x-3600/x^2=0 gives x^3=450, x=7.66 and y=600/x^2=10.2. A''=8+7200/x^3>0, so this is a minimum.

parts.label: b

Find P(20<T<27). [2]
Each of 18 patients attends independently with probability 0.78.

parts.label: d

questions.title: Normal and binomial distributions
solution:
z-values are -1.64485 and 1.28155. Thus sigma=14/(1.28155+1.64485)=4.78 and mu=18+1.64485sigma=25.9. Technology gives P(20<T<27)=0.483. For X~B(18,0.78),
P(X>=12)=0.920. More than two absent means X<=15, so the required conditional probability is P(12<=X<=15)/P(X>=12)=0.773.

stem: A geometric sequence has sum to infinity 6. The sequence formed by squaring every term has sum to infinity 18.

parts.label: a
parts.html: Find the first term and common ratio.

parts.label: b
parts.html: Let c_n=log_3(a_n)+k, where integer k>1. Show c_n is arithmetic.

parts.label: c
parts.html: Find the largest k for which the sum of the first 20 c_n is negative.

questions.title: Geometric and logarithmic sequences
solution: Let first term a and ratio r. Then a/(1-r)=6 and a^2/(1-r^2)=18. Dividing gives a/(1+r)=3; combining with a=6(1-r) gives r=1/3 and a=4. Now a_n=4(1/3)^(n-1), so c_n=log_3 4-(n-1)+k, arithmetic with difference -1. S20=20(log_3 4+k)-190<0, so k<9.5-log_3 4=8.238. The largest integer is 8.
